'''Second Floor Security''' was a security unit stationed [[Tarko-se/Legends|Tarko-se's]] [[Infinite Nebstar Casino|Casino]] on [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]]. They were all wiped out when the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of [[Galen Marek]] stormed the [[City/Legends|city]].
